title: Dual-architecture CI/CD pipelines with enforced verification gates
summary: GitHub Actions pipelines for continuous integration and dual-architecture macOS release, with scripts/verify.py and scripts/release.py acting as blocking gates.

steps: assert max RSS <= 512 MiB and report passed
codesign (Developer ID when secret present, ad-hoc fallback otherwise)

source.purpose: Produce the GPL-3.0-only corresponding source archive once per release from the release commit

steps: assert both arm64 and x86_64 DMGs present
assert exactly one corresponding source archive

gate_enforcement.verify_py: scripts/verify.py --gate offline is a required step before any packaging; non-zero exit fails the job
gate_enforcement.release_py: scripts/release.py verify --manifest is a required step after artifact assembly; checksum mismatch fails the job
gate_enforcement.soak_bound: CI parses soak_report.json and fails if max_rss_mb exceeds 512 MiB or report.passed is false

min_counts.rationale: A silently shrinking suite cannot pass the gate

release_py_changes: Added --arch {arm64,x86_64} so DMGs are architecture-tagged and never collide
Added --skip-source so the architecture-independent source archive is published once instead of per-arch
Manifest now records the built architecture

license_compliance.corresponding_source: OhMyCrypto-<version>-source.tar.gz built from the release commit via git archive
license_compliance.checksums: checksums.txt with SHA-256 per artifact, verified by scripts/release.py verify

validation.note: Workflows are validated by YAML parse and CLI contract checks; full execution requires GitHub-hosted runners and Apple signing secrets, which remain pending external authorization.
